def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    r=len(grid)-1
    # markers on the distinctive horizontal pattern project vertically upward;
    # put the marker at the top and color-1 trail beneath it.
    for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
        if v in (2,8):
            # vertical column reaches a fixed height determined by marker color
            height=5 if v==2 else 4
            top=max(0,r-height+1)
            out[top][c]=v
            for rr in range(top+1,r): out[rr][c]=1
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the row carrying the horizontal motif (the rest is blank).
    r=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    # The markers project upward, with a trail of color 1 beneath each.
    for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]):
        if v in (2,8):
            distance=4 if v==2 else 3
            top=max(0,r-distance)
            out[top][c]=v
            for rr in range(top+1,r): out[rr][c]=1
    return out
